name: Nawaabi enchilada sauce (cashew-cream, tomato, mild chile, saffron)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 3 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION: set by a food-safety professional)

lines.prep: bloomed in a spoon of warm water

method: Sweat the onion in butter; add ginger-garlic paste and cardamom; add passata and ancho and simmer 15 min.
Blend with the soaked cashews, cream and water until silky; pass through a sieve.
Return to heat, add saffron and kasuri methi, adjust salt; cool and chill.
food_safety: TREE NUT: cashew. Dedicated utensils and allergen label.
evidence: Practice: Mughlai/'nawaabi' gravies use a cashew-cream base (web-search snippet level). Enchilada sauce structure is Mexican. The combination is a NASHA proposal.
estimates_label: All quantities, yields, times and costs are preliminary estimates until a person cooks and measures them. Nothing here has been cooked or tasted.
